name: courtlistener-mcp-server
description: Search and retrieve US court opinions, federal dockets, judge records, citation networks, and oral arguments from CourtListener's 9M+ opinion corpus via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

courtlistener_api_token.title: CourtListener API token
courtlistener_api_token.description: Required. Free token from your account settings at courtlistener.com/sign-in. Free-tier limits are 5 req/min, 50/hr, 125/day; actual limits vary by token tier.
